en-US.title: Pizza Empire: Restaurant Sim
en-US.subtitle: Bake, serve & grow an empire
en-US.description:
Turn Nonna's tiny corner kitchen into the biggest pizza empire in the universe!

• Bake at the oven, ring the bell and watch your waiters serve hungry guests
• Fix the bottleneck: more stations, more waiters, more tables
• Open eight restaurants, from Napoli to a pizza planet in deep space
• Collect a staff of twelve characters and level them up
• Boxes to earn, daily missions and Rush Hour keep every visit rewarding
• Your restaurants keep earning Dough while you're away
• Franchise your empire to earn Chef Stars and grow faster every run
• Outsmart your rival, Big Cheese Carl

Pizza Empire is a relaxing restaurant sim you can play in short bursts all day.
